title: CorePerformanceFix x SortSmart
description: A high-performance optimization plugin focusing on entity-ticking efficiency and automated item-stacking and you can use SortSmart
body:
CorePerformanceFix x SortSmart 

CorePerformanceFix x SortSmart is a comprehensive server-side utility designed to enhance performance and stability for modern Minecraft servers. By addressing common lag sources such as excessive entity ticking and hopper inventory checks, this plugin ensures a smooth experience for players even under high load.

Key Features:
Intelligent Item Merging: Automatically scans for dropped items in a configurable radius and merges identical stacks to drastically reduce the total number of entities in the world.

Hopper Transfer Optimization: Implements a smart cooldown system for hoppers that are idling or attempting to push into full containers, significantly lowering CPU cycles spent on inventory updates.

Dynamic Entity Management: Enforces strict despawn rules for non-essential mobs spawned in distant chunks, freeing up valuable RAM and improving tick rates (TPS).

Eco-Sorting Gamification: Includes a unique interactive sorting assistant. Players can use /sortsmart to learn real-life recycling categories for Minecraft items, earning "Eco-XP" and competing on a global leaderboard.

Admin Control Suite: Administrators can toggle specific optimization modules in real-time using the /perf command to fine-tune the server's performance profile.

Optimize your server kernel today with CorePerformanceFix x SortSmart!
